# picolibc cross file for Astra 68.
#
# Astra's compiler owns the CPU, float, and thread-pointer ABI defaults.  Keep
# the libc build on that target so it cannot silently inherit Linux semantics.

[binaries]
c = ['m68k-astra-gcc', '-static', '-nostdlib', '-Wl,--build-id=none']
ar = 'm68k-astra-ar'
as = 'm68k-astra-as'
ld = 'm68k-astra-ld'
nm = 'm68k-astra-nm'
strip = 'm68k-astra-strip'

[host_machine]
system = 'unknown'
cpu_family = 'm68k'
cpu = '68030'
endian = 'big'

[properties]
link_spec = '--build-id=none'
skip_sanity_check = true
default_flash_addr = '0x00000000'
default_flash_size = '0x00400000'
default_ram_addr   = '0x00400000'
default_ram_size   = '0x00400000'
